title: Bias-Free FedGAN: A Federated Approach to Generate Bias-Free Datasets
reasoning: The paper's central theme is addressing an ethical issue: algorithmic bias in federated generative models. It specifically frames the problem in terms of unethical outcomes, such as a face synthesis model ignoring minority races. The proposed solution is evaluated based on its ability to produce fair and unbiased results, making ethics a core component of the work.
